reasons: Compliant finding with no redline and no counterparty comment, which is the expected output for a clause that meets the preferred position.

Cited paragraphs support the conclusion: fees are payable only as set out in the Fee Schedule (p0084), maintenance runs on a renewable one-year term (p0065), and Customer (Sparkling) has a 90-day termination-for-convenience right (p0118) — no take-or-pay, shortfall charge or volume cap on Customer.
Rationale correctly notes the residual open item (Schedule 'A' Fee Schedule not reproduced) as a confirmation point rather than inventing a deviation, which is appropriate for internal evidence.
No deterministic check failures and the original text is left unmodified, consistent with a compliant classification.
